node.title: Universe One
node.description: Create a bold impression with a sleek copy layout, opening gate transition, and a rhythmic image sequence synced to the music.

node.title: Blurred Orb
node.description: Cards drift and tumble erratically through soft-focus space; adjust rotation speed, erraticness, item size, border radius, spacing, distortion, and edge blur.

node.title: Machine
node.description: Your assets wrap around a tilted, rotating conveyor-belt cylinder; set roller diameter, belt thickness, spacing, corner rounding, speed, and shading.

node.title: Bentos
node.description: A scrolling bento-style grid cycles through your assets; set spacing, corner rounding, and scroll speed.

node.title: Spinning Wheel
node.description: Images stack and rotate vertically like a cylindrical wheel; set repeat count, corner rounding, vignette, spin direction, and speed.

node.title: Flipping Frame
node.description: A card that spins to reveal a second side, with title and label text floating off in 3D as it rotates. Customize front/back media, titles, labels, flip direction, corner rounding, media scale, hold time, fonts, and colors.
